items.title: ‘Picks and shovels’ trade comes unstuck as AI hardware stocks plunge on competitive threat from China
items.description: Asian stocks sold off sharply on Tuesday amid reports that China is now capable of manufacturing DUV lithography machines.

items.title: My financial adviser is against a withdrawal plan for my $2.3 million portfolio. Is he making a mistake?

items.title: ‘She is on Medicaid’: My sick friend pleaded with me to be her executor. Can I decline after she dies?
items.description: “She is in poor health and owns a home with a reverse mortgage that has been used to help pay for her caregivers.”

items.title: ‘I’m in my peak earning years’: I’m working beyond 70. Will that help increase my Social Security?

items.title: Actor Orlando Bloom tries again to sell Malibu beach house — now for $10 million
items.description: Hollywood star Orlando Bloom is making another attempt to sell his longtime Malibu beach mansion—relisting the property at a big discount, just a few weeks after it was taken off the market.

items.title: Nvidia’s potential new deal with OpenAI would revive a spooky tech-bubble habit, analyst warns
items.description: Investors are fretting over a report that Nvidia could backstop an OpenAI data-center lease, in what would be the largest such arrangement yet.

items.title: ‘I feel lucky’: I’m 71 and inherited $20,000. What should I do with this money?
